design.statistics: Two-sided paired randomisation test (sign flips) on per-query nDCG@10, 10000 resamples, seed 0; Holm correction across exactly L1 and L2; paired percentile bootstrap 95% CI over queries (10000 resamples, seed 0).
design.id_rule: Each book is shown with an id B1..Bn (R1: fused order; R2: catalog sorted by source and source_id). A returned id is read trimmed, without brackets and in upper case; ids that were not shown are dropped and counted, and so are repeated ids.
design.completion_rule: If fewer than 10 valid ids come back, the top 10 is completed with the remaining candidates in the order they were shown (fused order for R1, catalog order for R2); an unusable answer counts as zero valid ids.
design.matching_rule: a closed-book recommendation matches a catalog book when both titles are equal after normalisation (lower case, accents removed, every run of non-alphanumeric characters as one space), each cut before the first ':', '(', '[' or ' - ' (subtitles and edition notes ignored), and the last word of the recommended author's surname (the words before a comma, otherwise the last word; only the first of several authors) equals that of one of the book's authors. The first matching catalog book is taken; a book matched twice in one list is ranked once.

recommendations.title: The Last Day of the Republic
recommendations.author: Javier Cercas
recommendations.reason: Cercas returns to the theme with a fictionalized account of the final days of the Republican government, focusing on political betrayal and survival.

recommendations.title: The Sun Also Rises
recommendations.author: Ernest Hemingway
recommendations.reason: Though set just before the war, this novel captures the disillusioned 'Lost Generation' atmosphere that directly preceded and influenced the conflict.

recommendations.title: The Bridge at Alcántara
recommendations.author: Hilaire Belloc
recommendations.reason: An older but significant English novel that dramatizes the early stages of the war, focusing on the strategic importance of the bridge over the Tagus River.

recommendations.title: The Man Who Loved Dogs
recommendations.author: Leonardo Padura
recommendations.reason: While centered on Trotsky, the novel heavily features the impact of the Spanish Civil War on international leftist movements and exiles.

recommendations.title: The Ghosts of Spain
recommendations.author: Giles Tremlett
recommendations.reason: This book blends journalism and history to explore how the legacy of the Civil War continues to haunt modern Spanish society and politics.

recommendations.title: El nombre de la rosa
recommendations.author: Umberto Eco
recommendations.reason: Aunque ambientada en un monasterio medieval, su trama gira en torno a la herejía y la inquisición, siendo una obra maestra del género histórico.

recommendations.title: La catedral del mar
recommendations.author: Ildefonso Falcones
recommendations.reason: Esta novela histórica abarca el siglo XIV en Barcelona, donde los personajes enfrentan las tensiones religiosas y sociales que preceden a la Inquisición española.

recommendations.title: Los pilares de la tierra
recommendations.author: Ken Follett
recommendations.reason: Un clásico de la ficción histórica que explora la lucha entre la Iglesia y el poder secular, incluyendo escenas clave relacionadas con la persecución religiosa.

recommendations.title: El hereje
recommendations.author: Miguel Delibes
recommendations.reason: Retrata la vida de Cipriano Salcedo, un comerciante Valladolid acusado por la Inquisición, ofreciendo una visión íntima y crítica de ese periodo oscuro.

recommendations.title: La sombra del viento
recommendations.author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón
recommendations.reason: Aunque se centra en la Barcelona moderna, contiene elementos góticos y referencias históricas que evocan el peso de la censura y la memoria religiosa.

recommendations.title: Baudolino
recommendations.author: Umberto Eco
recommendations.reason: Otra obra de Eco que, aunque fantástica, profundiza en la mentalidad medieval y las estructuras de poder eclesiástico que definieron la era de la Inquisición.

recommendations.title: El último judío
recommendations.author: Noam Shpancer
recommendations.reason: Explora la identidad judía bajo la presión de la conversión forzada y la vigilancia inquisitorial en la España del siglo XV.

recommendations.title: La casa de los espíritus
recommendations.author: Isabel Allende
recommendations.reason: Aunque es realismo mágico latinoamericano, sus temas de opresión política y religiosa resuenan con las dinámicas de poder vistas durante la Inquisición.

recommendations.title: El código Da Vinci
recommendations.author: Dan Brown
recommendations.reason: Incluye tramas sobre secretos religiosos históricos y la influencia de organizaciones eclesiásticas, tocando tangencialmente el legado de la Inquisición.

recommendations.title: Siddhartha
recommendations.author: Hermann Hesse
recommendations.reason: Ofrece una perspectiva filosófica sobre la búsqueda espiritual individual frente a las dogmas institucionales, contrastando con la rigidez inquisitorial.

recommendations.title: I, Claudius
recommendations.author: Robert Graves
recommendations.reason: This classic novel offers a witty and intimate first-person account of the early Roman Empire through the eyes of Emperor Claudius.

recommendations.title: Masters of Rome: The First Man in Rome
recommendations.author: Colleen McCullough
recommendations.reason: McCullough’s meticulously researched series brings the late Republic and early Empire to life with deep political intrigue and historical accuracy.

recommendations.title: The Eagle of the Ninth
recommendations.author: Rosemary Sutcliff
recommendations.reason: A beloved adventure set in post-Boudica Britain that explores the mystery of the lost Ninth Legion within the context of the Roman Empire.

recommendations.title: Imperium
recommendations.author: Robert Harris
recommendations.reason: Told from the perspective of Cicero’s secretary Tiro, this novel vividly captures the rise and fall of power in the late Roman Republic.

recommendations.title: The Silver Pigs
recommendations.author: Lindsey Davis
recommendations.reason: As the first book in the Falco series, it introduces readers to detective work in ancient Rome during the reign of Vespasian.

recommendations.title: Memoirs of Hadrian
recommendations.author: Marguerite Yourcenar
recommendations.reason: This profound literary masterpiece presents a fictionalized autobiography of Emperor Hadrian, reflecting on his life and the empire he ruled.

recommendations.title: Roman Blood
recommendations.author: Steven Saylor
recommendations.reason: Saylor blends historical fact with fiction in this mystery featuring Gordianus the Finder, set against the backdrop of Cicero’s legal battles.

recommendations.title: The Last Legion
recommendations.author: Harry Sidebottom
recommendations.reason: An action-packed thriller that reimagines the final days of the Western Roman Empire and the fate of its last emperor.

recommendations.title: Nero Wolfe
recommendations.author: Rex Stout
recommendations.reason: While not strictly historical fiction, many stories feature Nero Wolfe as a descendant of a Roman family, offering a unique modern connection to imperial heritage.

recommendations.title: The Gates of Rome
recommendations.author: Conn Iggulden
recommendations.reason: The first book in the Emperor series, it dramatizes the childhood and rise of Julius Caesar, setting the stage for the transformation of the Republic into an Empire.

recommendations.title: La conquista del Perú
recommendations.author: Javier Reverte
recommendations.reason: Ofrece una narrativa novelada y rigurosa sobre la caída del Imperio Inca, combinando historia con un estilo literario accesible.

recommendations.title: El reino de este mundo
recommendations.author: Alejo Carpentier
recommendations.reason: Una obra maestra del realismo mágico que explora la revolución haitiana y las raíces coloniales en el Caribe.

recommendations.title: Los conquistadores
recommendations.author: Bartolomé de las Casas
recommendations.reason: Aunque es un testimonio histórico, su prosa dramática y denuncia apasionada lo convierten en una lectura esencial para entender la perspectiva crítica de la época.

recommendations.title: La casa de los espíritus
recommendations.author: Isabel Allende
recommendations.reason: Abarca la historia de Chile desde la llegada de los europeos hasta el siglo XX, entrelazando ficción familiar con eventos históricos clave.

recommendations.title: El nombre de la rosa
recommendations.author: Umberto Eco
recommendations.reason: Aunque ambientada en Europa medieval, su estructura de misterio histórico ha influido enormemente en cómo se narra la intriga durante la expansión colonial.

recommendations.title: Conquistadores: La epopeya de la América española
recommendations.author: Hugh Thomas
recommendations.reason: Presenta una narración detallada y fluida de las campañas militares y políticas que definieron la conquista, con gran rigor documental.

recommendations.title: La guerra de los mundos
recommendations.author: H.G. Wells
recommendations.reason: Inspirada directamente en la conquista de Tasmania por los británicos, esta novela ofrece una alegoría poderosa sobre el choque cultural y la dominación.

recommendations.title: El túnel
recommendations.author: Ernesto Sabato
recommendations.reason: Explora la psicología obsesiva y la alienación en la Argentina del siglo XX, reflejando las consecuencias sociales de la formación nacional post-colonial.

recommendations.title: Cien años de soledad
recommendations.author: Gabriel García Márquez
recommendations.reason: Retrata la fundación y evolución de Macondo como metáfora de toda Latinoamérica, incluyendo la llegada de la compañía bananera y la violencia estatal.

recommendations.title: La sombra del viento
recommendations.author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón
recommendations.reason: Aunque centrada en la Barcelona de posguerra, su trama histórica y gótica evoca el legado oscuro de siglos anteriores en la cultura europea y sus ecos en América.

recommendations.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
recommendations.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
recommendations.reason: This collection defines the genre with its iconic detective and quintessential Victorian London settings.

recommendations.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
recommendations.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
recommendations.reason: A masterpiece of atmospheric mystery that blends Gothic horror with logical deduction in the late Victorian era.

recommendations.title: The Moonstone
recommendations.author: Wilkie Collins
recommendations.reason: Often cited as the first modern detective novel, it features a complex plot centered around a stolen diamond in Victorian England.

recommendations.title: The Woman in White
recommendations.author: Wilkie Collins
recommendations.reason: A seminal sensation novel that pioneered the use of multiple narrators to unravel a dark conspiracy involving identity theft.

recommendations.title: A Study in Scarlet
recommendations.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
recommendations.reason: The debut novel that introduced Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson, establishing the template for future detective stories.

recommendations.title: The Sign of the Four
recommendations.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
recommendations.reason: A full-length adventure featuring Holmes' most personal case, rich with colonial intrigue and Victorian social dynamics.

recommendations.title: The Mystery of Edwin Drood
recommendations.author: Charles Dickens
recommendations.reason: Dickens' unfinished final work offers a haunting glimpse into Victorian crime, opium dens, and psychological suspense.

recommendations.title: Lady Audley's Secret
recommendations.author: Mary Elizabeth Braddon
recommendations.reason: A best-selling sensation novel that explores bigamy, madness, and class anxiety within the strict confines of Victorian society.

recommendations.title: The Leavenworth Case
recommendations.author: Anna Katharine Green
recommendations.reason: One of the earliest American detective novels, it showcases intricate legal mysteries and forensic details typical of the period.

recommendations.title: The Return of Sherlock Holmes
recommendations.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
recommendations.reason: This collection marks Holmes' dramatic return from death, delivering some of his sharpest deductions against Victorian criminals.

recommendations.title: El peregrino
recommendations.author: Paulo Coelho
recommendations.reason: Es la novela más famosa ambientada en el Camino de Santiago, donde el protagonista emprende una búsqueda espiritual hacia Compostela.

recommendations.title: La catedral del mar
recommendations.author: Ildefonso Falcones
recommendations.reason: Aunque se centra en Barcelona, incluye tramas y personajes que viajan por rutas jacobeas medievales, ofreciendo un contexto histórico rico.

recommendations.title: Camino de Santiago: La ruta francesa
recommendations.author: Varios autores (Guía oficial)
recommendations.reason: No es una novela de ficción pura, pero las guías literarias y narrativas de esta obra inspiran muchas historias basadas en la experiencia real del camino.

recommendations.title: El último peregrino
recommendations.author: Javier Moro
recommendations.reason: Una novela histórica que mezcla misterio y aventura con el trasfondo del Camino de Santiago durante la Edad Media.

recommendations.title: Santiago, el camino de los muertos
recommendations.author: José Luis Corral
recommendations.reason: Un thriller histórico ambientado en el siglo XII que utiliza el Camino de Santiago como escenario para resolver crímenes y conspiraciones.

recommendations.title: La sombra del viento
recommendations.author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón
recommendations.reason: Aunque no está totalmente ambientada en el Camino, contiene referencias culturales y viajes que evocan la tradición literaria española relacionada con peregrinajes simbólicos.

recommendations.title: Peregrinos
recommendations.author: Fernando Sánchez Dragó
recommendations.reason: El autor narra su propia experiencia y reflexiones filosóficas mientras recorre el Camino de Santiago, fusionando autobiografía y narrativa literaria.

recommendations.title: El código Da Vinci
recommendations.author: Dan Brown
recommendations.reason: Incluye capítulos cruciales ambientados en el Camino de Santiago y la catedral de Compostela, vinculándolos con secretos históricos y religiosos.

recommendations.title: Rutas y caminos de España
recommendations.author: Varios autores
recommendations.reason: Colecciones de relatos cortos y novelas breves que exploran diversas rutas españolas, incluyendo el Camino de Santiago como eje central de varias historias.

recommendations.title: La senda del peregrino
recommendations.author: Luis R. López
recommendations.reason: Una novela contemporánea que sigue a varios personajes en su viaje por el Camino, explorando temas de redención y encuentro personal.

recommendations.title: All the Light We Cannot See
recommendations.author: Anthony Doerr
recommendations.reason: This Pulitzer Prize-winning novel interweaves the stories of a blind French girl and a German boy, featuring strong themes of resistance against Nazi occupation in Saint-Malo.

recommendations.title: The Nightingale
recommendations.author: Kristin Hannah
recommendations.reason: A bestseller focusing on two sisters in France who take different paths to fight back against the Nazis, with one becoming a key figure in the underground resistance network.

recommendations.title: Suite Française
recommendations.author: Irène Némirovsky
recommendations.reason: Written during the war itself, this masterpiece depicts the complex social dynamics and quiet acts of defiance within occupied France, offering an authentic contemporary perspective on resistance.

recommendations.title: The Book Thief
recommendations.author: Markus Zusak
recommendations.reason: Narrated by Death, this story follows Liesel Meminger in Nazi Germany, where her family’s sheltering of a Jewish man represents a profound personal act of resistance.

recommendations.title: Birdsong
recommendations.author: Sebastian Faulks
recommendations.reason: While primarily set in WWI, its second half vividly portrays the French Resistance during WWII, exploring the psychological toll and moral ambiguities of fighting for freedom.

recommendations.title: The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet
recommendations.author: Becky Chambers
recommendations.reason: Note: This is science fiction. A better fit for strict historical accuracy would be 'The Girl Who Smiled Beads' or similar, but sticking to classic WWII fiction: Let's replace with 'The Zookeeper's Wife'. Actually, let's use 'The Zookeeper's Wife' by Diane Ackerman (non-fiction/narrative) or 'The La

recommendations.title: The Last Train to London
recommendations.author: Meg Waite Clayton
recommendations.reason: Based on true events, this novel follows Geertie and other characters involved in the Kindertransport and early resistance efforts to save children from Nazi persecution.

recommendations.title: Resistance
recommendations.author: Jill Paton Walsh
recommendations.reason: Set in occupied France, this YA novel tells the story of a young woman drawn into the resistance movement, highlighting the dangers and moral choices faced by ordinary citizens.

recommendations.title: The Paris Library
recommendations.author: Janet Skeslien Charles
recommendations.reason: Inspired by the true story of librarians at the American Library in Paris who defied Nazi orders to ban books, showcasing intellectual resistance and courage.

recommendations.title: Code Name Verity
recommendations.author: Elizabeth Wein
recommendations.reason: A gripping tale of two British women working in the SOE and the French Resistance, focusing on their bravery, friendship, and ultimate sacrifice against the enemy.

recommendations.title: La cocina mediterránea
recommendations.author: Ferran Adrià
recommendations.reason: Una obra fundamental que explora la esencia y los ingredientes clave de la dieta mediterránea con un enfoque culinario moderno.

recommendations.title: Cocina tradicional española
recommendations.author: Simone Ortega
recommendations.reason: Considerada la biblia de la cocina doméstica en España, ofrece recetas auténticas y fáciles de seguir basadas en productos locales.

recommendations.title: El sabor del Mediterráneo
recommendations.author: José Andrés
recommendations.reason: Combina la tradición culinaria mediterránea con técnicas contemporáneas, destacando el uso de aceite de oliva y pescados frescos.

recommendations.title: Cocina mediterránea: Recetas tradicionales
recommendations.author: Varios autores (Editorial Parragón)
recommendations.reason: Un recopilatorio visual y práctico que presenta platos clásicos de países como Italia, Grecia y España con instrucciones claras.

recommendations.title: La despensa mediterránea
recommendations.author: María José Sanz
recommendations.reason: Se centra en los ingredientes básicos de la región, enseñando cómo preparar recetas tradicionales aprovechando al máximo su sabor.

recommendations.title: Recetas de cocina mediterránea
recommendations.author: Nieves Barragán Mohacho
recommendations.reason: Aporta una perspectiva fresca pero respetuosa con la tradición, ideal para quienes buscan autenticidad en cada plato.

recommendations.title: Cocina andaluza tradicional
recommendations.author: Paco Morales
recommendations.reason: Representa fielmente una de las cocinas más emblemáticas del Mediterráneo, con recetas ancestrales y productos de la tierra.

recommendations.title: Mediterranean Food: The World's Healthiest Diet
recommendations.author: Salvatore Lupo
recommendations.reason: Aunque está en inglés, es una referencia académica y culinaria muy citada sobre la historia y las recetas tradicionales de la zona.

recommendations.title: Cocina italiana tradicional
recommendations.author: Marcella Hazan
recommendations.reason: Esencial para entender la rama italiana de la cocina mediterránea, con recetas puras y sin complicaciones innecesarias.

recommendations.title: Sabores del Mediterráneo
recommendations.author: Elena Reygadas
recommendations.reason: Ofrece una fusión elegante entre la tradición mediterránea y toques personales, manteniendo la esencia de los ingredientes naturales.

recommendations.title: The Oh She Glows Cookbook
recommendations.author: Angela Liddon
recommendations.reason: This book offers over 100 vibrant, whole-food plant-based recipes that are specifically designed to be healthy and satisfying without using any meat.

recommendations.title: Plenty: Vibrant Vegetable Recipes from London's Ottolenghi
recommendations.author: Yotam Ottolenghi
recommendations.reason: It revolutionizes vegetarian cooking by focusing on bold flavors and diverse vegetables, proving that meat-free meals can be incredibly rich and delicious.

recommendations.title: Forks Over Knives—The Cookbook
recommendations.author: Del Sroufe and Robert Ostfeld
recommendations.reason: Based on the famous documentary, this collection provides strictly whole-food, plant-based recipes aimed at improving health and preventing disease through diet.

recommendations.title: Thug Kitchen: The Official Cookbook
recommendations.author: Thug Kitchen (Jesse Thorne and Michal Mirecki)
recommendations.reason: With its edgy humor and straightforward instructions, it makes healthy, vegan-friendly cooking accessible and fun for beginners looking to ditch meat.

recommendations.title: Smitten Kitchen Every Day
recommendations.author: Deb Perelman
recommendations.reason: While not exclusively vegetarian, it features a massive section of reliable, everyday vegetable-forward recipes that are easy to prepare and inherently healthy.

recommendations.title: The Moosewood Cookbook
recommendations.author: Mollie Katzen
recommendations.reason: A classic staple in vegetarian cuisine, it provides timeless, wholesome recipes that focus on natural ingredients and simple, meat-free preparation methods.

recommendations.title: PlantPower Kitchen
recommendations.author: Jessica Cording and Adam Kilian
recommendations.reason: Created by registered dietitians, this book ensures every recipe is nutritionally balanced, making it an ideal guide for healthy, no-meat eating.

recommendations.title: Vegan Heartland
recommendations.author: Derek Dammart
recommendations.reason: It brings comfort food classics into the plant-based realm with hearty, healthy recipes that prove you don't need meat for satisfying meals.

recommendations.title: The Complete Vegetarian Cookbook
recommendations.author: America's Test Kitchen
recommendations.reason: This comprehensive guide uses scientific testing to ensure every meat-free recipe works perfectly, offering a wide range of healthy options for all skill levels.

recommendations.title: Green Kitchen: The New Seasonal Cooking
recommendations.author: Kirsten Tibballs
recommendations.reason: Focused on seasonal produce, this book encourages a healthy lifestyle by connecting readers with fresh, local vegetables and creating simple, meat-free dishes.

recommendations.title: Postres sin horno
recommendations.author: María José Sanz
recommendations.reason: Este libro está dedicado exclusivamente a recetas de postres que no requieren cocción en el horno, ideal para principiantes.

recommendations.title: Dulces sin horno: Recetas fáciles y rápidas
recommendations.author: Varios autores (Editorial Parramón)
recommendations.reason: Ofrece una amplia variedad de opciones sencillas como mousses, tartas frías y chocolates caseros sin necesidad de horno.

recommendations.title: Postres rápidos y fáciles
recommendations.author: Silvia Rueda
recommendations.reason: Incluye numerosas secciones de repostería fría y sin horno, enfocándose en la rapidez y simplicidad de los ingredientes.

recommendations.title: La cocina de los dulces sin horno
recommendations.author: Cocina Fácil
recommendations.reason: Una guía práctica con paso a paso detallado para elaborar postres frescos y deliciosos utilizando solo refrigeración o congelación.

recommendations.title: Recetas de postres sin horno para toda la familia
recommendations.author: Ana María Serrano
recommendations.reason: Presenta ideas familiares y nutritivas que evitan el uso del horno, perfectas para días calurosos o cocinas pequeñas.

recommendations.title: Chocolates y bombones caseros sin horno
recommendations.author: Javier Rodríguez
recommendations.reason: Se especializa en confitería casera fácil, mostrando cómo hacer trufas y bombones sin necesidad de hornear.

recommendations.title: Tartas frías y mousse: Postres sin horno
recommendations.author: Laura González
recommendations.reason: Enfocado en texturas cremosas y bases de galleta, este libro es perfecto para quienes buscan elegancia sin complicaciones técnicas.

recommendations.title: Repostería fácil: Sin horno y sin gluten
recommendations.author: Marta López
recommendations.reason: Combina la facilidad de no usar horno con adaptaciones saludables, ofreciendo recetas accesibles y rápidas.

recommendations.title: El arte de los postres fríos
recommendations.author: Chef Paco Roncero (Edición divulgativa)
recommendations.reason: Aunque incluye alta cocina, tiene capítulos específicos sobre preparaciones frías y montajes simples que no requieren horneado.

recommendations.title: 100 Postres sin horno en 15 minutos
recommendations.author: Editorial Blume
recommendations.reason: Su promesa principal es la velocidad y la ausencia de horno, haciendo coincidir perfectamente con la búsqueda de 'fácil' y 'sin horno'.

recommendations.title: Essentials of Classic Italian Cooking
recommendations.author: Marcella Hazan
recommendations.reason: Considerato il testo definitivo per la pasta fresca fatta in casa e le salse tradizionali italiane.

recommendations.title: The Silver Spoon
recommendations.author: Phaidon Editors
recommendations.reason: Un'enciclopedia completa della cucina italiana con centinaia di ricette autentiche di pasta e sughi.

recommendations.title: Pasta: The Definitive Guide to Making, Shaping, and Cooking Fresh Pasta
recommendations.author: Jill Dupleix
recommendations.reason: Guida pratica focalizzata specificamente sulla tecnica di impasto e abbinamento con salse casalinghe.

recommendations.title: Italian Food Forever
recommendations.author: Carlo Petrini
recommendations.reason: Celebra gli ingredienti semplici e le preparazioni classiche che rendono la pasta italiana unica.

recommendations.title: La Cucina Italiana
recommendations.author: Gambero Rosso
recommendations.reason: Raccolta autorevole di ricette regionali che includono molte varianti di pasta al sugho fatto in casa.

recommendations.title: Olive Oil & Garlic: A Celebration of the Mediterranean Kitchen
recommendations.author: Nancy Harmon Jenkins
recommendations.reason: Offre una prospettiva autentica sulle basi delle salse italiane, come aglio, olio e pomodoro fresco.

recommendations.title: The Art of Pasta
recommendations.author: Evangelina B. Kozlowski
recommendations.reason: Combina tecniche storiche e moderne per creare paste ripiene e condimenti equilibrati.

recommendations.title: Simple Italian Cooking
recommendations.author: Giuliano Bugialli
recommendations.reason: Enfatizza l'uso di ingredienti freschi e metodi tradizionali per ottenere salse ricche e genuine.

recommendations.title: Pasta Classica
recommendations.author: Anna Villirillo
recommendations.reason: Libro dedicato esclusivamente alla preparazione manuale della pasta e alle sue salse più comuni.

recommendations.title: Cucina Regionale Italiana
recommendations.author: Vincenzo Agnesi
recommendations.reason: Presenta ricette locali dove la pasta fatta in casa è protagonista insieme a salse tipiche del territorio.

recommendations.title: Tapas y pinchos: La cocina española en miniatura
recommendations.author: José Andrés
recommendations.reason: Ofrece una guía moderna y accesible para preparar auténticas tapas españolas con técnicas profesionales.

recommendations.title: El libro de las tapas
recommendations.author: Karlos Arguiñano
recommendations.reason: Recetas tradicionales y fáciles de seguir por uno de los chefs más populares de España.

recommendations.title: Cocina de tapas y pinchos
recommendations.author: Ferran Adrià
recommendations.reason: Explora la evolución creativa de la tapa desde la perspectiva del maestro de la vanguardia culinaria.

recommendations.title: Tapas: The Little Dishes of Spain
recommendations.author: Penelope Casas
recommendations.reason: Un clásico internacional que detalla la historia y variedad regional de las pequeñas platos españoles.

recommendations.title: Pinchos y tapas de Bilbao a San Sebastián
recommendations.author: Mikel Iturbe
recommendations.reason: Se centra específicamente en la cultura del pincho vasco, ofreciendo recetas locales auténticas.

recommendations.title: La cocina española en casa: Tapas y raciones
recommendations.author: Simone Ortega
recommendations.reason: Enseña cómo adaptar las recetas clásicas de bares a la cocina doméstica con sencillez.

recommendations.title: Tapas and Pintxos: A Journey Through Spain's Culinary Traditions
recommendations.author: David Kinch
recommendations.reason: Combina fotografía atractiva con explicaciones culturales sobre el origen de cada plato.

recommendations.title: Recetario de tapas caseras
recommendations.author: María del Carmen González
recommendations.reason: Ideal para principiantes, con ingredientes económicos y pasos claros para cocinar en casa.

recommendations.title: El arte de la tapa
recommendations.author: Alberto Chicote
recommendations.reason: Propone combinaciones gourmet y presentaciones elegantes para sorprender a invitados.

recommendations.title: Cocina vasca: Pinchos y tapas
recommendations.author: Martín Berasategui
recommendations.reason: Destaca por su enfoque en productos frescos del norte de España y técnicas refinadas.

recommendations.title: The Beginner's Guide to Sourdough
recommendations.author: David Gassner
recommendations.reason: This book is specifically designed for novices, offering clear, step-by-step instructions and troubleshooting tips that demystify the sourdough process.

recommendations.title: Sourdough: A Beginner's Guide to Making Bread at Home
recommendations.author: Alexandra Stafford
recommendations.reason: Stafford provides a gentle introduction with accessible recipes and practical advice on maintaining a starter, making it ideal for first-time bakers.

recommendations.author: Grant Achatz

recommendations.title: Cocina de autor
recommendations.author: Andoni Luis Aduriz
recommendations.reason: Explora la creatividad conceptual y la experimentación sensorial desde la perspectiva de la nueva cocina vasca.

recommendations.title: Molecular Gastronomy: Exploring the Science of Flavor
recommendations.author: Hervé This
recommendations.reason: Profundiza en la interacción entre química y sabor, proporcionando herramientas teóricas para la innovación culinaria.

recommendations.title: The Professional Chef
recommendations.author: The Culinary Institute of America (CIA)
recommendations.reason: Incluye capítulos extensos sobre técnicas modernas, emplatado y gestión de cocina profesional actualizada.

recommendations.title: Pride and Prejudice
recommendations.author: Jane Austen
recommendations.reason: This novel is a quintessential classic of English literature, renowned for its wit and social commentary.

recommendations.author: George Orwell
recommendations.reason: A foundational dystopian classic that remains critically relevant in discussions on surveillance and truth.

recommendations.title: The Great Gatsby
recommendations.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
recommendations.reason: Widely considered the definitive American classic exploring wealth, love, and the Jazz Age.

recommendations.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
recommendations.author: Harper Lee
recommendations.reason: A modern classic celebrated for its profound moral insights and enduring cultural impact.

recommendations.title: Moby-Dick
recommendations.author: Herman Melville
recommendations.reason: An epic literary classic that defines the American canon with its complex symbolism and narrative.

recommendations.title: War and Peace
recommendations.author: Leo Tolstoy
recommendations.reason: Often cited as one of the greatest classics ever written, offering a sweeping historical panorama.

recommendations.title: Jane Eyre
recommendations.author: Charlotte Brontë
recommendations.reason: A Victorian classic that revolutionized the novel form with its strong female protagonist.

recommendations.title: The Odyssey
recommendations.author: Homer
recommendations.reason: One of the oldest and most influential classics in Western literature, defining the hero's journey.

recommendations.title: Crime and Punishment
recommendations.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
recommendations.reason: A psychological classic that deeply explores morality, guilt, and redemption.

recommendations.title: Frankenstein
recommendations.author: Mary Shelley
recommendations.reason: A pioneering Gothic classic that established many tropes still central to science fiction today.

recommendations.title: Guerra y paz
recommendations.author: León Tolstói
recommendations.reason: Es la obra maestra que explora el impacto de las guerras napoleónicas en la sociedad rusa.

recommendations.title: Sin novedad en el frente
recommendations.author: Erich Maria Remarque
recommendations.reason: Ofrece una visión cruda y desgarradora de la Primera Guerra Mundial desde la perspectiva de los soldados.

recommendations.title: El arte de la guerra
recommendations.author: Sun Tzu
recommendations.reason: Es el tratado estratégico más influyente sobre tácticas militares y conflictos bélicos.

recommendations.title: Por quién doblan las campanas
recommendations.author: Ernest Hemingway
recommendations.reason: Retrata la lucha personal y colectiva durante la Guerra Civil Española con gran intensidad narrativa.

recommendations.title: La Ilíada
recommendations.author: Homero
recommendations.reason: Narra los últimos años de la legendaria guerra de Troya, definiendo el género épico bélico.

recommendations.title: Los desastres de la guerra
recommendations.author: Francisco de Goya (contexto histórico/literario)
recommendations.reason: Aunque es una serie gráfica, su título es icónico para describir el horror absoluto del conflicto armado.

recommendations.title: Guerra al mundo
recommendations.author: H.G. Wells
recommendations.reason: Presenta una invasión alienígena como una guerra total contra la humanidad, pionera en ciencia ficción bélica.

recommendations.title: El señor de los anillos: Las dos torres
recommendations.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
recommendations.reason: Centra la trama en la preparación y el estallido de una guerra masiva contra fuerzas oscuras.

recommendations.title: Crónica de una muerte anunciada
recommendations.author: Gabriel García Márquez
recommendations.reason: Explora la violencia social y familiar como una micro-guerra silenciosa dentro de una comunidad.

recommendations.title: La casa de los espíritus
recommendations.author: Isabel Allende
recommendations.reason: Documenta las consecuencias devastadoras de los golpes de estado y guerras civiles en Latinoamérica.
